# Christ City Church

> Christ City is a new church taking shape in La Mirada, California, led by co-pastors Kenny and Kim Baker. Launch Sunday is March 7, 2027.

- Sunday gatherings: Heights Christian Schools, Bluefield Campus, 12900 Bluefield Ave, La Mirada, CA 90638
- Co-pastors: Kenny Baker and Kim Baker
- Affiliation: Evangelical Covenant Church
- Launch Sunday: March 7, 2027
- Text: 562-724-4465 (text only). Email: kenny@christcityla.church
- House churches: La Mirada, Norwalk, Whittier, Bellflower
- Give online: https://christcityla.churchcenter.com/giving
